name: Startup Ranking

sources.title: Third-party flow documentation — submit starts at /startup/create/url-validation (URL check precedes the form); social login (Google/Facebook/LinkedIn/X); fields incl. name, legal name, 60-char slogan, country+state, URL, founding date, business type, industry, tags, description, socials, email, phone; free queue >80 days; $25/$49 faster approval in 24h (content read via search result; homepage behind bot check)
Third-party guide — ownership verification via HTML file upload, tweet from official handle, or domain email; 'Claim Startup' to publish (content read via search result)
ToS — paid services: SR Booster, SR Pro, SR Advertising (content read via search result)

conditions: Free submission exists but joins an approval queue the site itself describes as 80+ days — $25 (Basic) or $49 (Premium) buys 24-hour approval plus New Startups placement and newsletter exposure
requirements: Social login only — Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, or X (site says it takes name, email, picture)
Submission flow starts at /startup/create/url-validation — the URL is validated before the form appears; /startup/submit is a 404
Fields: startup name, legal name, 60-char slogan, country AND state/region (both required and public), URL, founding date, business type, industry, tags, description, socials, contact email, phone
Ownership verification required: HTML file upload, tweet from the official handle, or domain email
Paid upgrades: faster approval ($25/$49), SR Booster, SR Pro, SR Advertising
Site sits behind a security interstitial/bot check on first visit
preparation: A social account to log in with
Region info — both country and state/region are required and shown publicly
Verification route ready (HTML file to your server is fastest)
Patience for the ~80-day free queue, or budget for the $25 skip
workflow: Log in with a social account at startupranking.com
Click Create Startup -> /startup/create/url-validation and validate the URL
Verify ownership (HTML file / tweet / domain email) and claim
Wait for approval — ~80+ days free, or pay for 24-hour review
watchFor: Free queue is exceptionally long (~80 days per the site's own page) — plan accordingly
State/region is mandatory and public — a con for founders wanting location privacy
Conflicting third-party claims on dofollow vs nofollow links — treat as unknown
Ranking metrics are based on web/social presence — a profile exists on their own terms
countsAsLive: The startup profile is approved and public at startupranking.com with a link back to the site
unknowns: Whether outbound links are dofollow (sources conflict)
